tc.research_text.ADAMINITECRAFTING: An infusion of earth, fire and magic
tc.research_page.thaumicadditions.ADAMIN: Infuse thaumium with enchanted fabric, amber, diamonds and nether stars to produce adaminite. The infusion requires considerable stability and a large supply of Ignis.
tc.research_page.thaumicadditions.MITHRI: Infuse thaumium with diamonds, salis mundus, enchanted fabric and amber to obtain two mithrillium ingots.
tc.research_page.thaumicadditions.CAP_AD: First infuse a thaumium cap with adaminite, diamonds and a zombie brain. Awaken the inert cap with eight portions of salis mundus. A charged adaminite cap reduces the base vis cost to 50%. Use two matching charged caps when assembling a wand.
tc.research_page.thaumicadditions.CAP_MI: Infuse a thaumium cap with two mithrillium ingots and a diamond, then awaken it with eight portions of salis mundus. A charged mithrillium cap reduces the base vis cost to 75%. Inert caps cannot be used to assemble a wand.
tc.research_page.thaumicadditions.ROD_AD: Strengthen a silverwood rod with adaminite, diamonds and salis mundus through infusion. The finished rod holds 2000 vis of each primal aspect and can be assembled with a pair of charged wand caps.

Arrange two adaminitewood rods diagonally with a primal charm at the upper end on an arcane workbench. The core holds 4500 vis of each primal aspect. Assembly of the core costs 500 vis of every primal aspect. The finished staff glows and displays runes.
tc.research_page.thaumicadditions.ADAMIN: Infuse a thaumium sword with two adaminite ingots and two diamonds. Sneak while holding the blade in your main hand to damage nearby living creatures. Sneak and right-click to cycle between 5 HP every 10 ticks, 15 HP every 20 ticks and 30 HP every 60 ticks. The aura reaches 10 blocks along each axis, including through walls. It can affect animals and other players. Normal hits do not wear down the blade.
tc.research_text.ADAMINITEARMOR: A complete set of adaminite armor
tc.research_page.thaumicadditions.ADAMIN: Infuse each thaumium armor piece with two adaminite ingots and two diamonds. The helmet also requires goggles of revealing. Worn armor draws from a nearby vis network: Aer for the helmet, Terra for the chestplate, Aqua for leggings and Ignis for boots. Each piece stores up to 80000 charge. Charge increases by one per tick when supplied and decreases by one per tick without supply. Charged pieces reduce vis costs, with a larger discount for Ignis. A charged helmet reveals aura nodes and Thaumcraft information. Each piece provides 5 warp while worn.
tooltip.thaumicadditions.sword_aura_cont: Sneak to activate; Sneak + Right Click to change mode
tc.research_text.SINGULARITYCORE: A stable core for further experimentation
tc.research_page.thaumicadditions.SINGUL: Infuse a mithrillium ingot with two blocks of obsidian, an ender pearl and salis mundus to create a black hole core. The core is inert and has no right-click ability. It is a component for future singularity research.
tc.research_text.ENCHANTEDWOOD: Infusing magical timber with primal vis
tc.research_page.thaumicadditions.ENCHAN: Infuse a greatwood log with four oak logs and four units of each primal aspect to produce enchanted greatwood. Infuse a silverwood log with four enchanted greatwood and eight units of each primal aspect to produce enchanted silverwood. These are crafting materials rather than placeable blocks.
tc.research_page.thaumicadditions.TAINTE: Add 16 Vitium and wheat seeds to a crucible to create tainted seeds. Plant them on dirt, grass or farmland. Mature plants yield seeds and tainted roots. Growth and yields improve in a tainted biome. Bone meal advances growth.
tc.research_text.VISTRANSPORTEVOLVED: Transporting vis and taint through enchanted conduits
tc.research_page.thaumicadditions.VISTRA: Combine enchanted greatwood with glass panes on an arcane workbench to produce sixteen vis conduits. Connected conduits share a buffer of sixteen units of vis and taint. Right-click a side with a wand to toggle its connection. A filter connects along its placement axis and gradually removes taint. These conduits carry the mixture produced by the old crucible and condenser, rather than the primal vis distributed by Thaumcraft relays.
tc.research_text.INFUSER: Combining ingredients with a supply of vis
tc.research_page.thaumicadditions.INFUSE: Craft an infuser on an arcane workbench. Connect a vis conduit or magic tank to its sides or bottom. Ingredients must occupy the positions shown in the infusion recipe book; unused positions must be empty. To make the book, put a normal book in the upper input and supply 4 vis. Products appear in the central slot and any depleted shard appears in the lower output. The machine pauses when its outputs are full.
tc.research_text.INFUSERDARK: Infusing with both vis and taint
tc.research_page.thaumicadditions.INFUSE: In a normal infuser place an infuser in input 1, thaumium ingots in inputs 2, 3, 4 and 6, and nitor in input 5. Supply 18 vis to obtain a dark infuser. It combines five positional inputs while consuming separate amounts of vis and taint. Place a normal book in its upper input and supply 4 vis and 2 taint to obtain a dark infusion recipe book. A dark infuser carries 3 warp while held.
advancement.thaumicadditions.creative_no: Tap some vis from creative aura node using your wand, sceptre, or staff.
tc.research_page.thaumicadditions.ARCANE: Infuse a chest with eight thaumium ingots to make an arcane transporter. Right-click a block to store its state and contents. Right-click another block to place the stored block in the empty space against that face. A loaded transporter glows. A cancelled or unsuccessful placement keeps its contents. The transporter holds one block and cannot be stacked.
tc.research_page.thaumicadditions.TRANSM: Use the transmutation stone on stone or stone bricks to make their arcane counterparts. Sneak to reverse the process. Sneak-use on a diamond block to make a runic matrix. These transformations do not consume the stone or vis.
tc.research_text.VISCONDENSATOR: Does this act bad on aura?
tc.research_page.thaumicadditions.VISCON: A condenser slowly depletes a primal or balanced shard, producing vis and a depleted shard. Connect its sides or bottom to the vis transport network. Install up to two speed or efficiency upgrades by using them on the block; use a wand to remove the last upgrade. One shard lasts 24000 processing steps and yields 24 vis, or 48 with two efficiency upgrades.
tc.research_page.thaumicadditions.INFUSI: Place the activator directly above a runic matrix. Use a wand on the activator to insert it, then use an empty hand to retrieve it. The activator periodically activates the matrix for the owner who placed it. The owner must be online in the same dimension and allowed to interact with the matrix. Higher capacity rods shorten its activation cycle.
tooltip.thaumicadditions.relic_wrong_own: This is not your relic! It belongs to %s!
tc.research_text.ARCANEDICE: What shall I give to you?...
tc.research_page.thaumicadditions.ARCANE: Hold the arcane dice for one second to exchange it for a random relic. The dice carries 3 warp. By default it can grant the Hallelujah Wand; other add-ons can register more prizes. A relic binds to its first owner. Carrying another player's relic causes damage. Hold the Hallelujah Wand for five seconds to summon primed TNT with a 460-tick fuse. The wand is reusable.
tooltip.thaumicadditions.infinite_dispen: This singularity is infinite in the dispenser.
tc.research_page.thaumicadditions.SINGUL: Infuse a black hole core with alumentum and nitor to make two arcane singularities. Throw one or launch it from a dispenser. On impact it anchors, draws in nearby entities and tears apart blocks when mob griefing permits it. Dropped items feed it; nearby singularities merge and alumentum becomes new singularities. At 2000 active ticks or 2000 absorbed item entities it collapses in five explosions. A creative dispenser variant is available in the creative tab.
advancement.thaumicadditions.basicwand.d: Craft a wooden wand with any cap.
advancement.thaumicadditions.greatwoodwa: Craft a greatwood wand with any cap.
advancement.thaumicadditions.silverwoodw: Craft a silverwood wand with any cap.
advancement.thaumicadditions.voidwand.de: Craft any wand with void cap.
advancement.thaumicadditions.alchemy.des: Use your wand on a cauldron from vanilla.
advancement.thaumicadditions.thaumium.de: Make thaumium ingot in a crucible.
tooltip.thaumicadditions.xp_vis_return: Returns 1 vis of each primal aspect per level.
focus.upgrade.thaumicadditions:purity.te: When projectile collides with entity, than it will have regeneration for 30 second, but if it lands on ground, it will spread some pure vis around the landing point, clearing taint in 8 block radius.
focus.upgrade.thaumicadditions:infection: When projectile collides with entity, than it will have flux poison for 30 second, but if it lands on ground, it will spread some taint around the landing point.
focus.upgrade.thaumicadditions:explosive: When projectile collides with anything, it will create an explosion with regular TNT power. The more level is - the more explosion power you will get.
tc.research_page.thaumicadditions.WANDFO: This focus launches a drifting orb for 2 vis of each primal aspect, before wand discounts and Frugal upgrades. Its cooldown is half a second. Infection and Purity are mutually exclusive: Infection poisons living targets or spreads flux on impact, while Purity regenerates living targets, encourages animals to breed and clears nearby flux. These effects last 30 seconds and cannot be removed with milk. Explosive adds TNT-strength explosions for each upgrade level. Seeker is available at rank three. An orb without these upgrades has no direct damage effect.

Hold use with this focus attached to turn 10 vis of every primal aspect into one experience level per tick. Infection reverses the exchange: one level restores 1 vis of every primal aspect, up to the wand's capacity. No level is spent when every aspect is full. This focus can only be upgraded with Infection.
seal.noeffect.globe: This seal combination doesn't have any abilities.
seal.tillsoil.1.globe: Tills soil in 13 by 13 area, and
seal.tillsoil.2.globe: soil will be wet all the time.
seal.breaksoil.1.globe: Destroys soil in 13 by 13 block radius.
seal.collect.globe: Collects all items within 16 block radius.
seal.harveset.globe: Harvests all fully-grown seeds from vanilla Minecraft.
seal.fluxclean.globe: Cleans flux in the 16 block radius.
seal.whisper.globe: Whispers to all nearby players some secrets...
seal.warp.1.globe: Warps all players within 5 block radius
seal.teleportation.1.globe: Click with 'Dislocation Amulet' to bind it.
tc.research_page.thaumicadditions.ARCANE: Place a seal against a block face. Install up to three charged symbols in order by using them on the seal. Use a wand to remove the last symbol. Different ordered combinations activate different effects; a crystal ball explains the current combination. Breaking a seal retains its color and symbols. Combine a seal with dyes in a crafting grid to recolor it without losing its symbols.
tc.research_page.thaumicadditions.SEALSY: Blank symbols are made by infusing blaze powder with three gold nuggets. Charge them in a seal inscriber using essentia from a jar. Each symbol carries one aspect. A seal reads its symbols in the order they were installed.

Place a filled essentia jar above the inscriber. Use blank symbols on the frame to insert a batch, then use an empty hand to retrieve it. One unit of essentia charges the whole batch with the jar's aspect. Item transport can insert blanks and extract charged symbols.

tc.research_page.thaumicadditions.GRANUM: Combine Plant and Life (Herba + Victus) to discover Seed — Granum. Life + Earth still produces Herba.
tc.research_page.thaumicadditions.SAXUM: Combine Earth with Earth to discover Stone.
tooltip.thaumicadditions.source.infuser: Made in the regular Thaumic Additions infuser. See its recipe book or the infuser category in EMI/JEI/REI. Supply VIS through conduits, not from a wand.
tooltip.thaumicadditions.source.hyper_no: Creative block: no recipe or survival acquisition. Changes the aspects of the node above it according to the number of items inside without consuming them.
tooltip.thaumicadditions.source.void_che: No crafting recipe. Found in the underground chambers of ancient monoliths. It can be mined and moved; placing it again does not generate new loot.
Creative variant. Generates loot once when placed; no crafting recipe. Ordinary loot chests occur in ancient monoliths.
emi.thaumicadditions.network_supply: Supplied through vis conduits. This is neither essentia nor wand vis.
